searchText: <@725415098331430932> <@543900561460822016> I think the issue with focil is worse than it seems. How is it not profitable for the builder to have deals with includers to include very low paying txs of their own that the builder can invalidate when they win the auction? One of the properties of focil should be that secondary markets should not appear but I think this is itself an auction among existing builders to land in the IL. Also the mempool waiting doesn't really solve the original problem
